name: newvcs-server
description: The part of newvcs that has to be agreed on: one Durable Object per repository, owning its refs

scripts.build:hasher: cd hasher && RUSTFLAGS='-C target-feature=+simd128' cargo build --release --target wasm32-unknown-unknown && wasm-opt -O3 --enable-simd --enable-bulk-memory --enable-nontrapping-float-to-int --strip-debug --strip-producers target/wasm32-unknown-unknown/release/newvcs_hasher.wasm -o ../src/blake3.wasm
scripts.build:merger: cd merger && cargo build --release --target wasm32-unknown-unknown && cp target/wasm32-unknown-unknown/release/newvcs_merger.wasm ../src/merger.wasm
